mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200k.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals a potential inflation overshoot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% in the past 3 months, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1% and INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5%.
